excerpt.zh: 虚境的神秘对于我们来说异乎寻常，难以消弭，但是我们和[GetShroudPatron]的协调更加融顺了。无论我们去往哪里，我们都能感受到它在我们思绪的背后，它的能量渗过心灵的缝隙进入我们的现实。
excerpt.en: The mysteries of the Shroud are too alien for us to dispel, but we have become more attuned to the [GetShroudPatron]. Everywhere we go, we can sense it at the back of our minds, and its power seeps into our reality from the cracks of our psyche.
